full_page.content:
1934, June 9
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O. F.M. Cap.
(Mildred Casey Conley, daughter of James and Emma Casey)
St. Bonaventure Monastery 1740 Mt. Elliott Ave. Detroit, Mich. June 9, 1934
Miss Mildred Casey Camp Fire Girls St. Paul, Minn.
Dear Mildred: -
I hope you are well. I've tried a number of times to start this card; now its 10:15 P.M. Was just talking with Mary. She is in great hopes that you will succeed in getting "Mother and Dad Jim" for a trip East. I think it would give (Jim at least) them another lease of ten yrs ....... Be sure and write them I said so. I've been wanting to write them so long. Have about sixty letters ahead to answer. ..
Well! Well: so Annie O Brien is to celebrate her golden Wed'g. I remember her quite well - knew before she was married. I surely will remember them in Mass tomorrow.
Fr. Solanus, 0.9.M. Cap.
